# Short Term Rental For Sale
> Marketplace and resource for buying and selling short-term rental properties.

## About
Short Term Rental For Sale connects buyers and sellers of short-term rental properties. The site provides listings, market data, and resources for investors looking to purchase turnkey STR properties or sell their existing vacation rentals.

## Key Pages
- Home: https://www.shorttermrentalforsale.com/
- Listings: https://www.shorttermrentalforsale.com/listings
- Resources: https://www.shorttermrentalforsale.com/resources
